text:
Nina Park: Heads up 1: partner marketplace launch timeline needs finalizing. We have the webinar, blog, two benchmark assets, and a marketplace listing. Can we lock dates?
Samir Kaur: Suggestion: webinar on 5/10, blog on 5/17, marketplace listing live 5/20. That gives GA promo window.
Liam O'Connor: Works for me if SEs can commit to a dry-run week of 5/3. Need runway for performance checks.
Priya Desai: I'll draft two short benchmark one-pagers: 1) latency/cost tradeoff, 2) quality/regression note. Marketing will turn those into 1 slide each for the webinar.
Nina Park: Good. Lead flow question 1: partner leads -> do we send as SFDC leads plus webhook to partner CRM, or only webhook?
Samir Kaur: Both. SFDC lead with partner.routing=marketplace and webhook to partner CRM for partner-sourced enrichment. SLA 48h for initial contact.
partner-bot: @Samir Kaur 1: webhook template ready. Provide partner_id and destination URL. Will append utm_source=partner_marketplace.
Priya Desai: Messaging note 1: keep benchmark bullets consumer-facing. Avoid raw throughput tables. Use relative statements like "up to 3x faster"
Liam O'Connor: For the webinar demo, we'll pin model v2.3-quant and run the 256/512 scripted prompts. I'll add the exact numbers in the SE runbook (not public).
Nina Park: Creative needs: hero image, 2 social tiles, email header. Can design deliver by Tue?
Priya Desai: Yes 1: I'll upload copy drafts by Mon EOD. Also drafting a short co-authored blog brief to send to partner.
Samir Kaur: Promotion cadence: 2 weeks pre-webinar drip (announce, social push, partner email), 1 week reminder, day-of final push. Post-webinar: blog + gated assets then nurture.
partner-bot: @Nina Park 1: partner has approved co-branding guidelines attached: https://files.example.com/partner-guidelines.pdf
Liam O'Connor: Quick tech ask 1: need dedicated demo slot for webinar with warm cache. Ops, can we reserve?
ops-bot: Reserved: 1 dedicated slot on 5/10 08:00-12:00 PT. Confirmed.
Nina Park: OK team 1: I'll publish a calendar with milestones and assign owners. Final ask: can someone volunteer to own the post-webinar co-authored blog coordination?
Priya Desai: I'll take post-webinar blog coordination and partner edits.
Samir Kaur: I'll own lead routing + SFDC fields mapping.
Liam O'Connor: SE dry-run + runbook here.
Nina Park: Thanks all. I'll drop the milestone doc in this thread in 30m. React with :white_check_mark: when you've added your tasks in the doc.
Samir Kaur: 705
Priya Desai: 705
Liam O'Connor: 705
